messages:
claire: Hey — trying to pull the APAC model-health dashboard for svc-inference and getting a 403. Link I tried: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/service-overview?var-region=apac
claire: Error is: "You do not have permission to view this dashboard". Any quick way to check what role I'm missing?
aj: you might be missing the org role or the grafana team. Do you see the "Request access" button on the grafana page? :eyes:
claire: no button, just the 403 page.
aj: ok. two quick checks: 1) are you logged in with SSO (google) or SAML? 2) ping the platform group to ensure you're in eng-viewers. If you want, paste your email and i'll run a perm check.
claire: logged in via SSO, email claire@redwood.ai — appreciate the assist.
platform-bot: Permission check queued. ticket# 4521. Notifying eng-platform on-call.
aj: thanks — putting the links here you probably want:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/service-overview
- Model health panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/efgh5678/model-health
- Loki logs (svc-inference): https://loki.redwood.internal/explore?orgId=1&query=%7Bjob%3D%22svc-inference%22%7D
- Tempo traces: https://tempo.redwood.internal/trace/ (filter by service=svc-inference)
sam: Claire — added you to eng-viewers via SSO group mapping. Should propagate in a minute. If still blocked i'll escalate to infra.
platform-bot: SSO group sync completed for claire@redwood.ai. Added to group: eng-viewers.
claire: trying the grafana link again... loading... :crossed_fingers:
claire: sweet — i can see the dashboard now. thanks y'all.
natalie: FYI if you need per-model latency traces in Tempo, use this span filter: service="svc-inference" and tag.model_name="gpt-small-quant" and duration>50ms.
natalie: example trace query: trace.span.service="svc-inference" AND trace.tags.model_name:"gpt-small-quant"
aj: also if you're tuning alerts, we put runbook + suggested alert thresholds here: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/OBS/Service+Alert+Runbooks
claire: perfect. i'm going to add an alert tweak request to the runbook for apac model saturations. thanks for the quick help everyone :rocket: 
sam: marked ticket#4521 resolved. let me know if you want me to open a follow-up to broaden eng-viewers -> eng-readonly for other contractors.
claire: not now, but noted. closing thread.
